outcomes.name: Understanding of the vision has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The vision is consistently understood and referenced everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that understanding of the vision varies across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are.
Identify why the vision hasn't landed consistently in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish visible sponsorship of the vision.
Confirm the vision is being consistently referenced by leaders across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor leadership messaging to ensure the vision stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey staff in underperforming teams/sites to understand why the vision hasn't taken hold.
Develop targeted messaging to address the specific gaps in understanding identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted vision reinforcement sessions in teams/sites where understanding is weakest.
Confirm understanding of the vision has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks so gaps in understanding of the vision are caught early in future.
